text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the train home after taking Twin Turbo 
out, as per her wish to play outside.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, Twin Turbo had fallen 
asleep standing up."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mmm... I can't eat another bite~~~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Traaaineerrr......?
choice_data_list:
It's dangerous to fall asleep while 
standing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Twin Turbo to either wake up or sit 
in her seat, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no way... I don't wanna get up... I 
don't wanna move at all...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer, give me a piggyback 
ride~... If you do, I might just wake up 
for you~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Piggyback, piggyback, piggybaaaack...

Now, now, you little tomboy. Don't go 
causing too much trouble for your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Nature? Ah, it is Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Getting dragged around like that must be 
pretty tough on you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, wake up already. We're arriving 
at the station. If you don't wake up, I'm 
leaving you behind.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? No! No!! No way~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahaaa~~n!! Don't leave Turbo 
behind~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey! We're on a train! Be quiet, will 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then Nature, hold my hand! Trainer, you 
too! Then I'll walk for you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're hopeless. ...Trainer, could 
you help too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Nice Nature holding one of Twin 
Turbo's hands and me holding the other, we 
walked along the path back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in the evening light, the shadows 
of the three stood side by side in 
heartwarming harmony, just like a 
close-knit family.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Look, we're here. —Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh... Ehehe, Mama, Papa...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Who are you calling your parents? Come on, 
up you get.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? It's the academy. Did Turbo just 
teleport...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Good grief, you're so carefree.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She's quite a handful, you must have a 
tough time, Trainer~
choice_data_list: I'll be fine with this much.

I'll be giving you proper guidance from 
now on.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oooh! That's my Trainer for ya!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, you spoil me way too much. 
Don't blame me if I end up totally selfish 
and completely out of control, okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Trainer is so sweet after all~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature has a point, but... We'll 
cross that bridge when we get to it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Turbo doesn't wanna do anything 
harsh~~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nature, save me! Do something~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that nice, compared to being 
neglected? You're being properly taken 
care of, after all.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Is that true?! Then Trainer, you're gonna 
stay with me foreeeever?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that sounds great~! Trainer and 
Turbo, together forever~♪
